question: To what established ritual model are the worship and applications compared?
premises: Worship and related acts are prescribed.
Applications and related practices are prescribed.
These are said to be the same as those for the nine Durgās.
inference: The worship and applications are taught as equivalent to those of the nine Durgās.
plain_english: Worship and so forth, and applications and so forth, are remembered as the same as for the nine Durgās.
